voci.testo: Former Yesh Atid MK Yoav Segalovitz to run with the United Arab List (Ra'am)
Ofer Winter forms a new political party, called "Amcha Yisrael"
Former Yesh Atid MK Yoav Segalovitz announces he will run with the United Arab List (Ra'am) as a technical bloc
Likud MK Tally Gotliv announces she is running with Otzma Yehudit
The Religious Zionist Party and Zehut agree to run together as a technical bloc
Submission of candidate lists to the Central Elections Committee opens at 4 PM IST and closes at 10 PM IST
Submission of candidate lists to the Central Elections Committee opens at 1 PM IST and closes at 5 PM
Zionist Home leader Hili Tropper announces he is running with Yashar, dissolving his alliance with The Reservists, which then merges with the New Economic Party
Final day of submission of candidate lists to the Central Elections Committee, which opens at 4 PM IST and closes at 10 PM IST
First day of submission of candidate lists to the Central Elections Committee, which opens at 1 PM IST and closes at 5 PM
Together and Yisrael Beiteinu sign a surplus-vote agreement
Yashar and The Democrats sign a surplus-vote agreement
Joint List and Ra'am sign a surplus-vote agreement

voci.chiude: Apri `dati/eventi-grezzi.json`, cerca `"stato": "nuovo"`. Per ognuna: o la traduci — riga italiana in `EVENTI` dentro index.html, e la voce passa a `"tradotto"` — o la scarti portandola a `"scartato"`. GIUDIZIO: se la voce meriti la cronologia lo decide una persona; la data NON si tocca, sposta il marcatore sull'asse.
